run: one website research run, 1 to 3 attempts of up to 7 model steps

findings.confirm: How often generateText throws NoObjectGeneratedError with finishReason 'length' in website research, from the Workers logs or the seo spend rows.
findings.problem: When website research ends with output that does not parse, retryInvalidOutput runs the whole request again, up to two more times, as a fresh tool-using conversation with the same 6000-token output limit. It never looks at the error's finishReason, so an answer cut off at the limit (reasoning tokens count toward it) is retried the same way and is likely to be cut off again.
findings.change: In the catch, read error.finishReason. On 'length', raise maxOutputTokens for the next attempt (or lower the effort or the amount asked for) instead of resending the same request; keep the retry as it is for a normal stop with bad JSON.
findings.why: Each attempt re-runs up to seven model steps and the paid searches and page reads they trigger, and bills the full output again. A reply that hit the limit repeats the same cost and the same failure.
findings.estimate: up to about 6,000 output tokens plus a full tool loop per wasted attempt, at most two attempts per run (estimate)
findings.assumptions: Only runs whose first attempt ends in a length cut-off are affected; how many that is is not known from the code. Prompt figure assumes about seven steps of a few thousand input tokens, mostly cached.
findings.verify: Force a small maxOutputTokens in a test, make the model reply long, and check that the second attempt is sent with a larger limit and that the number of search calls does not double.

notes.title: SAM meters a missing OpenRouter cost as zero, where the other paths fail closed
notes.problem: SamChatAgent.ts:426 and :257 read the step cost through openRouterCostUsd, which returns 0 when providerMetadata has no openrouter.usage.cost (chatAgent.ts:34-37). The other hosted paths use requireOpenRouterCostUsd (chatAgent.ts:44-51), whose comment says hosted should fail closed when the cost is missing. A hosted SAM step whose reply lacks the cost field is therefore billed nothing and the turn goes on.
notes.change: Use requireOpenRouterCostUsd in SAM's onStepFinish and compaction path, or log a warning when the cost is absent on hosted, so a provider route that drops usage accounting is seen.
notes.verify: In a test, pass providerMetadata {} on a hosted turn and check that the turn errors or logs, instead of recording 0.

notes.title: The compaction summary call has no output limit, no deadline and no finish check
notes.problem: summarizeForCompaction calls generateText with only a model and a prompt, over a transcript that has passed an estimated 120,000 tokens (SamChatAgent.ts:84). It sets no maxOutputTokens and no abortSignal, so a stalled provider holds the turn until the platform stops it, and result.text is stored as the summary without reading finishReason; a summary cut off by a provider default limit replaces the history it summarises.
notes.change: Add a maxOutputTokens sized for the summary and an AbortSignal.timeout like the other generateText calls in the repo (60 to 120 seconds), and throw or keep the old history when finishReason is 'length'.
notes.verify: Stub the model to return finishReason 'length' and check that compaction does not store the partial text.
